details.title: NGSI-LD control
details.description: A switch, a button, a slider or a number that sets one attribute of an entity at a broker c³ knows, through c³ - a light on, a setpoint

preference.name: broker
preference.label: Broker
preference.description: The broker's URL, as c³ knows it (picked in the widget)

preference.name: entity
preference.label: Entity
preference.description: The entity's id - a selection wired to the widget replaces it

preference.name: kind
preference.label: Control
preference.description: switch (a boolean), button (sends Value), slider or number

preference.name: label
preference.label: Label
preference.description: Shown above the control - empty: the attribute's name

preference.name: step
preference.label: Step
preference.description: The slider's and the number's step

preference.name: refresh
preference.label: Refresh
preference.description: Read the value again every so many seconds (0: never)

inputendpoint.name: entity
inputendpoint.label: Entity
inputendpoint.description: {broker, tenant, entities: [the entity set]} - a table's or a map's selection
